name: Cervo Hotel, Costa Smeralda Resort
positioning: Pastel-hued hotel overlooking the Piazzetta and Marina of Porto Cervo on Sardinia's Costa Smeralda, with a freshwater pool at its heart and a white-sand private beach
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in the heart of Porto Cervo, steps from the Marina
Couples drawn to modern Sardinian design and a suite with a rooftop Jacuzzi
Guests who want a private beach and water sports on the Costa Smeralda

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Piazzetta of Porto Cervo and its Marina.
The hotel is a short stroll from the Marina, shopping promenades and nightlife.
The hotel is on the Sardinian Riviera, also known as the Costa Smeralda.
Pink stone and pastel facades frame the hotel.
Architect Luigi Vietti designed Cervo Hotel to blend into the landscape and welcome travelers arriving by sea.
Rooms have whitewashed walls, custom-made furniture, pastel hues and hand-crafted textiles in a modern Sardinian design.
The Presidential Suite has a rooftop terrace with a private Jacuzzi and panoramic views of Porto Cervo Bay.
Some guest rooms have a Marina view and a terrace.
A freshwater pool lies at the heart of the hotel.
Cervo Hotel has a white-sand private beach.
Water sports include waterskiing, paddleboarding and canoeing.
Agora, the hotel's bar and lounge, overlooks the Marina and the Piazzetta.

highlights.text: The hotel overlooks the Piazzetta of Porto Cervo and its Marina, a short stroll from shopping promenades and nightlife.
Cervo Hotel has a white-sand private beach.
A freshwater pool with sun beds and umbrellas lies at the heart of the hotel.
The Presidential Suite has a rooftop terrace with a private Jacuzzi and panoramic views of Porto Cervo Bay.
Architect Luigi Vietti designed Cervo Hotel, framed by pink stone and pastel facades, to blend into the landscape.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Olbia Costa Smeralda Airport, approximately 35 km from the hotel.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
